goals.title: Improve /Users/shinyoohag/Desktop/frametrace gui/evidence-viewer with...
goals.objective: Improve /Users/shinyoohag/Desktop/frametrace gui/evidence-viewer with Korean-first forensic UI copy plus a practical preview/window-mode review flow for video and recovered evidence candidates. Preserve the dirty worktree. Keep changes scoped to gui/evidence-viewer unless evidence artifacts are needed. Verify with real browser surface evidence at desktop/tablet/mobile and record ULW evidence/checkpoint. Success criteria: C001 Korean-first page copy and forensic statuses are visible without launch hype; C002 video/recovered evidence candidates can be opened in a preview/window-like mode with report/export/status flow still reachable; C003 JS/static/cargo regression checks pass and runtime QA cleanup is recorded.

successCriteria.scenario: Browser happy path: run python3 -m http.server 4192 --directory gui/evidence-viewer, run agbrowse start --headed, navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4192/index.html, resize 1280 900, capture agbrowse snapshot/screenshot/console. PASS iff the first screen is Korean-first, keeps forensic terms like local-first/candidate-unvalidated/verification required visible as status labels, and has no launch-hype copy or console errors.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Korean-first forensic home screen verified in headed agbrowse/browser session: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/frametrace-ko-preview-window/desktop-home-1280.png, desktop-home-1280-overflow.json (1280 clientWidth=scrollWidth, previewRendered=false, local-first/candidate-unvalidated/verification required true), desktop-home-1280-snapshot.txt, desktop-home-1280-console.txt (no console output), navigate-final.txt, cleanup-receipt.json.

successCriteria.scenario: Browser edge path: with the same headed agbrowse session, click a video/recovered evidence candidate preview control, then click the window-mode control. Capture agbrowse screenshots/snapshots/console/overflow at 375, 768, and 1280. PASS iff preview/window surfaces show the selected candidate media metadata, validation status, report/export controls remain reachable, ESC/close works, and scrollWidth equals clientWidth for mobile/tablet/desktop.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/frametrace-ko-preview-window/mobile-preview.png/json/txt, tablet-preview.png/json/txt, desktop-window.png/json/txt, preview-flow-actions.txt, overflow JSONs, cleanup receipt.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Preview/window-mode flow verified across desktop/tablet/mobile: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/frametrace-ko-preview-window/desktop-window.png, desktop-window-overflow.json; tablet-preview.png, tablet-preview-overflow.json; mobile-preview.png, mobile-preview-overflow.json; mobile-preview-snapshot.txt; mobile-preview-console.txt; mobile-preview-agbrowse.png from agbrowse screenshot; preview-close-escape.json shows hidden=true/rendered=false after Escape; all overflow=false and report/export/verify controls present.

successCriteria.scenario: Regression auxiliary path: run node --check gui/evidence-viewer/app.js, node --check gui/evidence-viewer/data.js, node --check gui/evidence-viewer/translations.js, git diff --check for gui/evidence-viewer files, a static assertion script for Korean labels and preview/window selectors, and cargo test --lib if feasible. PASS iff all commands pass or any non-GUI failure is explicitly classified outside this change.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Regression checks passed: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/frametrace-ko-preview-window/node-check-app.txt, node-check-data.txt, node-check-translations.txt, git-diff-check-gui.txt, static-assertions.json (hidden_preview_rule/no_launch_hype true), cargo-test-lib.txt (160 passed), cleanup-receipt.json (agbrowse stopped, port 4192 not listening).
